base.description: R4116-F9002-A1 - DS6001, 2OU, 64 x 1.6TbE, COMe 8C / 64 GB DDR4 / 256 GB SSD. The only order code; the earlier STORDIS datasheet rev 100925 prints the same code with 32 GB.

description: Celestica DS6001 - 2OU Open Rack v3, 64-port 1.6TbE OSFP224 hybrid liquid-cooled data centre switch on a Broadcom Tomahawk 6 (102.4 Tbps), fed from the rack's 48 VDC bus bar. The front is a black bezel with two banks of eight OSFP224 columns, four rows each (two stacked pairs), the system lamps, USB-C console and reset in the gutter between the banks, 1PPS/10 MHz, MGMT, USB, CPU and BMC consoles and ToD at the left and two stacked SFP56 management ports (numbered 65 and 66) at the right. The rear carries a liquid quick-disconnect pair at each end, four fan modules (3+1) in two pairs, and the ORv3 bus-bar connector in the middle. No installation guide exists; this is a DRAFT from the datasheet and vendor renders whose only square-on images fail the aspect gate.

gaps.note: Celestica's documentation portal stops at the DS5000; no DS6001 guide URL resolves (intake probe 2026-09-26).
gaps.wanted: The DS6001 installation guide: LED tables, port-lamp mapping, coupler supply/return and size, bus-bar connector part, fan numbering, and a dimensioned elevation.

gaps.note: Both square-on renders read aspect 5.88 against 537/94 = 5.713 (2.9%), so no position here is measured; every one is a fraction of a datasheet dimension.
gaps.wanted: A dimensioned drawing, a 3D model, or a photograph with a known dimension in frame, to fix the face height and take positions to better than estimated. This is what holds the device at draft.

gaps.note: Four lenses per column; which port each serves and their colours are unpublished.
gaps.wanted: The port LED table, or a photograph of a live unit with a known port lit.

gaps.note: Ports 1-10 print "-HP"; the datasheet gives "Up to 32W / 40W transceivers" without a port split.
gaps.wanted: Which ports take 40 W optics, from the guide or a Celestica optics support note.

gaps.note: STORDIS labels them "QD Direct Liquid Cooling"; the datasheet says only 35 C facility water inlet. Standard (UQD, ORv3 blind-mate), size, and which are supply and which return are not held.
gaps.wanted: The coupler specification and supply/return assignment, and the coolant flow rate.

gaps.note: The datasheet says "48VDC Bus bar input"; no connector part or current rating is given.
gaps.wanted: The bus-bar clip part number and rating, and the tray's power consumption.

gaps.note: No typical or maximum power, and no fan draw, anywhere in the datasheet.
gaps.wanted: The DS6001 typical and maximum power, and the split between air and liquid heat load.

gaps.note: No fan legend is printed on either rear render; fans are numbered left to right as seen from the rear by convention.
gaps.wanted: A photograph of the rear showing fan labels, or the guide's fan-replacement figure.

gaps.note: The left-cluster RJ45s' keyway side does not resolve at 1.9 px/mm; they are drawn unrotated. On the DS6000 the same vendor's jacks are keyway up.
gaps.wanted: A close photograph of the DS6001 left cluster.

Which way each OSFP block faces. Rows 3 and 4 on the held renders are too dark to read, and the sibling DS6000's render suggests 0/0 over 180/180 rather than the 0/180 drawn here. A lighter photograph or an installation-guide elevation of the front settles it; until then every pair is held in stack-exceptions.

waive.L125: An Open Rack v3 tray, sized in OPEN RACK units (2OU, 48 mm each), not EIA rack units. A 19-inch `ru` would be a conversion the hardware never makes - 96 mm is 2.16 U and the tray does not fit an EIA rack at all - and `mount` has no Open Rack value yet. Until one exists this device states neither, and its DCIM export keeps the 1U it has always written (#734).

name: ds6001

cooling.note: "Hybrid cooling technology", "Liquid cool: 35 C liquid inlet with data center facility water" (datasheet rev 120325); the title calls it "Hybrid Liquid Cooled". STORDIS's rear legend adds "QD Direct Liquid Cooling" for the four couplers and "3+1 FANS". What is liquid-cooled (the switch ASIC's cold plate is the likely reading) and how the heat splits between air and water are not stated.

gate-1.note: FAILS, SO THIS DEVICE STAYS AT DRAFT. The front bezel reads 1032.4 x 175.6 px (x 84.6-1117.0, y 314.4-490.0) and the rear body 1003.3 x 170.7 px; both give aspect 5.88 against the datasheet's 537/94 = 5.713, 2.9% out, identically on two independent renders. With x scaled to 537 the face comes out about 91.3 mm tall, so the datasheet height evidently includes something the face does not (a tray rail or lip); with y scaled to 94 the face would be 552 mm wide, wider than the stated overall width, which is impossible. Neither image has a feature of independently known size to settle it (the OSFP apertures read 22.9 wide, which agrees with the x scale, but their drawn height of 10.7 mm is the render's inset, not the cage). Every position here is x as a fraction of 537 and y as a fraction of 94, and is estimated.

lifecycle.note: Datasheet rev 120325 is current on the Foleon page; no end-of-sale or end-of-life notice found there or on the STORDIS page, so none-announced.

power.note: "48VDC Bus bar input" - the tray has no supplies of its own; the rack's power shelf feeds the bus bar. chassis.power is `dc`, the nearest word the schema has: its `dc` is described as telecom -48 V, and an ORv3 bus bar is a positive 48-54 V rail, which is recorded here and in attrs rather than bent into the vocabulary. No power figure of any kind is given.

sources.note: A DATASHEET AND VENDOR RENDERS, AND NO INSTALL GUIDE. Celestica DS6001 datasheet rev 120325 (Foleon; the earlier STORDIS rev 100925 differs only in title and order-code memory). Celestica's documentation portal stops at the DS5000 (intake probe 2026-09-26). Images: STORDIS square-on front (ds6001-F, 1200 x 800; ds6001-F-2 with a callout) and rear (ds6001-B, 1200 x 554, with callouts 1 QD couplers, 2 "3+1 FANS", 3 BUS BAR), and three Foleon three-quarter renders (ds6001-A 3781 px, -A-2, -A-3 front and rear stacked), used for identity, legends and counts only.

the-clusters.note: Left: 1PPS and 10 MHz SMA jacks at (12.7, 36.1) and (24.7, 36.1); a bright shell 10.2-26.9 across holding MGMT (RJ45 with lamps), USB and CPU CONSOLE top to bottom; a second shell holding BMC CONSOLE over TOD at x 40.0; each legend printed slanting beside its jack. The jacks' keyway side is not resolved at 1.9 px/mm and they are drawn unrotated. Centre gutter: PWR, ALM, STAT, FAN lamps at x 269.7, y 22.9-41.6 with legends to their left, the USB-C console standing vertical at (265.0, 54.0) and RST at 67.5. Right: the luggage tag lying landscape at the top (celestica/lug-tag@1, rotate 0, label "DS6001" as ds6001-A-3 prints it) with "LUG TAG" printed under it, and the two SFP56 cages stacked at x 509.9 (upper 0 / lower 180, per L108), printed "SFP56 65" above and "SFP56 66" below. Honeycomb vent fields fill the corners, drawn as estimated extents on backing rects.

the-hp-ports.note: Ports 1-10 are printed with an "-HP" suffix; the datasheet says "Up to 32W / 40W transceivers" without saying which ports take which. That -HP marks the higher-power positions is the natural reading and is NOT stated anywhere held; see the hp-ports gap.

the-osfp-wall.note: TWO BANKS OF EIGHT COLUMNS, FOUR ROWS, NUMBERED DOWN EACH COLUMN. Column centres fit 71.16 + 23.30 k (left bank) and 302.7 + 23.30 k (right bank) - cages abutting at 23.3, 0.2 mm over std/osfp@1's 23.1 - and row centres read 16.06, 36.4, 55.2 and 75.6. The legends between rows 1-2 and 3-4 read `1-HP (up)(down) 2-HP` and `3-HP (up)(down) 4-HP` in column 1, so column k holds ports 4k+1 to 4k+4 top to bottom and the right bank starts at 33; ds6001-A-3 confirms "33 34" and "35 36" at its first column and "-HP" on ports 1 to 10 only. Rows 1-2 and 3-4 are each a stacked pair, drawn upper 0 / lower 180, and that turn is HELD, NOT SETTLED (#799): the OSFP MSA rev 5.22 seats both ports of a stacked cage the same way up, rows 3-4 are too dark on the renders to read, and the sibling DS6000 reads 0/0 over 180/180. Every pair is named in stack-exceptions; the gap stacked-osfp-orientation says what settles it. The drawn aperture on the render is 22.9 x 10.7; the std/osfp@1 13.5 mm height is used and fits between the rows with 6.8 mm for legends.

the-port-lamps.note: Four round lenses per column, two above row 1 and two below row 4, at the column centre +/-8.0 mm, y 6.0 and 85.4 - one per port, but which port each serves is unpublished, so each names its pair collectively (as on the DS6000, whose wall is laid out the same way).

the-rear.note: ds6001-B: a coupler plate at each end (0-67.8 and 471.0-537 mm) each carrying two QD couplers in dished recesses centred x 30.8 and 504.4, y 21.5 and 72.0 (a first read from a gridded crop put them at 28.5 / 509.4; the matched-scale overlay moved them); four fan modules 61.6 x 66.2 at x 88.3, 157.8, 320.2 and 389.8 under grey cover plates; the bus-bar connector on its plate in the middle at 240.9-301.6 x 39.3-74.7. The fans carry no printed numbers on either render, so fan-1 to fan-4 run left to right as seen from the rear by convention only.

width-and-flanges.note: THE BLACK BEZEL IS THE 537 MM BODY; THE ORv3 FURNITURE IS OUTSIDE IT. On ds6001-F the bezel spans 1032.4 px; outside it sit small grey tabs (about 4 mm at the left, 3 mm at the right, at mid-height) and black rail bars along the bottom reaching 10-17 mm past each edge, which are the tray's rack latches and slides. 537 mm is the Open Rack v3 IT tray width and the datasheet's overall width, and it is the bezel that scales to it with the ports symmetric about the face centre to 0.1 mm (bank midpoint 600.8 px against a face centre of 600.8). The tabs, rails and the two blue lifting handles folded along the top edge (with their "DO NOT LIFT BY HANDLE" labels on ds6001-A-3) are not drawn, as ears are not. COLOUR follows the Celestica ruling - black faceplate, otherwise silver chassis - and the DS6001 renders agree with it: chassis.color is the sheet metal (#c4c8cc; the rear, lid and sides are silver on ds6001-B and ds6001-A-3) and the front's black is a full-face `bezel` decor (#16181b).

stack-exceptions.reason: HELD AS DRAWN, NOT A READING OF THIS TURN (#799). The OSFP MSA rev 5.22 draws its stacked 2x1 cages with both ports the same way up (section 7.1, Table 7-1), so 0/180 is not a stacked cage; but the renders of this face are too dark in rows 3 and 4 to read which way either cage of a lower block faces, and the sibling celestica/ds6000 suggests the lower blocks are the upper ones turned over (0/0 over 180/180) rather than all 0. The geometry is held until it is decided; the gap stacked-osfp-orientation says what settles it.
